feature_name: Enhanced Library API for Cargo Shuttle
description: Improve the cargo-shuttle library's API surface to make it more usable for external consumers. Expose the argument parsing module publicly and implement command-specific return types so callers can handle different command outputs appropriately.
functional_requirements: Make the args module publicly accessible from the library API
Design a return type system that varies based on which shuttle command was executed
Ensure the library properly returns command outputs for beta functionality
Update library documentation to reflect the new public API surface
Maintain backward compatibility where possible while acknowledging breaking changes
Update integration tests to verify the new library API behavior
